description: Check whether AtlantFlow serves a location. Returns status 'served' (primary service area), 'ask' (listed or nearby but availability must be confirmed by phone) or 'not_served' (outside Palm Beach, Broward and Miami-Dade). Give a ZIP whenever possible.

city.description: City name, e.g. 'Delray Beach'. Used when no ZIP is known.
city.title: City

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code of the property, e.g. '33487'. Preferred - gives a definite answer.
zip.title: Zip

name: check_service_area
title: Check service area by ZIP
